# Publisher template provenance

Retrieved 2026-09-21 from the LaTeX2e Proceedings Template link on
https://link.springer.com/series/558/information-for-authors-and-editors.

Download URL:
https://cms-resources.apps.public.k8s.springernature.io/springer-cms/rest/v1/content/27851904/data/LaTeX2e%20Proceedings%20Template%20ZIP

The archive's class identifies itself as `2026/09/03 v2.25`. The publisher's
sample uses `newtxtext` and `newtxmath` with `varvw`; the manuscript follows it.
The class and bibliography style are copied unchanged into `paper/` so local
and hosted builds use the same versions. The accompanying publisher README and
history are retained here. The unmodified `samplepaper.tex` is also retained for
format comparison (its example figure remains in the source archive).
Publisher files remain attributed to Springer; no project license is assigned to them.
